name: FrostGuard apple scab detector

dataset.name: PDD – Apple – Scab (Roboflow Universe, thesis-okplj/pdd-apple-scab v1)
dataset.origin: PlantVillage leaf photographs (lab conditions, single leaf on plain background)
dataset.val_split: 20 % random hold-out of train (seed 42); the dataset version ships no validation split

intended_use: Decision support: confirming visible scab lesions on single apple-leaf photos.
limitations: Trained on 160 lab photos of single leaves; expect false positives on fruit, field scenes, microscopy or cluttered backgrounds.
Validation set is small (40 images), so metrics carry wide uncertainty.
Weights derive from Ultralytics YOLO11 and are distributed under AGPL-3.0.
